brands.name: B. Clem Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped custom surfboards by Brent Clem in Honolulu — longboards, midlengths, fish, retro twins, and performance logs with high-gloss fiberglass finishing.

models.name: Abider Glider
models.description: A glider model for the ultimate single fin experience. Length: 10–12 ft. Width: 23"+. Thickness: 3"+. Fin(s): Single fin.

models.name: Billy Duke
models.description: The Billy Duke represents a contemporary evolution of the modern Pig model. Length: 9–10 ft. Width: +/- 23". Thickness: 3". Fin(s): Single fin.

models.name: El Cabrón
models.description: A traditional log that rides shorter and faster. Length: 8–10 ft. Width: +/- 23". Thickness: 3". Fin(s): Single fin.

models.name: El Medio
models.description: An easy-to-surf, modern midlength for intermediate surfers and mediocre surf conditions. Length: 6'10–8 ft. Width: +/- 21". Thickness: 2.75". Fin(s): 2+1.

models.name: Log Jammin'
models.description: Capable of tackling waves ranging from one-foot slop to overhead surf, the Log Jammin' stands out as a must-have midformance longboard. Length: 9–10 ft. Width: +/- 23". Thickness: 3". Fin(s): Single fin, 2+1.

models.name: Minutia
models.description: The Minutia is built for surfers who want classic noseriding confidence without sacrificing agility. Length: 9–10 ft. Width: +/- 23". Thickness: 3". Fin(s): Single fin.

models.name: O'Dell Twin
models.description: Replica of a retro twin fin from the 80s era of surfing. Length: 6–7 ft. Width: +/- 20". Thickness: +/- 2.5". Fin(s): Twin fin.

models.name: Pizza Pizza
models.description: The Mini Simmons pays homage to surfing legend Bob Simmons, who pioneered hydrodynamic theory and speed in the sport. Length: 5–6 ft. Width: +/- 21". Thickness: 2.75". Fin(s): Twin fin.

models.name: Retro Fish
models.description: Classic retro fish with updated curves and rocker. Length: 5–6 ft. Width: +/- 21". Thickness: 2.75". Fin(s): Twin fin.

models.name: Slacker
models.description: A classic Tracker shape — the missing link in the evolution from long to shortboard. Length: 7–8 ft. Width: +/- 21". Thickness: 2.75". Fin(s): Single fin.

models.name: Townie
models.description: This POG (performance log) will have you smiling as you cross step from nose to tail in all conditions. Length: 9–10 ft. Width: +/- 23". Thickness: 3". Fin(s): Single fin.

models.name: Town Tooter
models.description: A midformance log with a really rolled back end and slightly pulled-in nose. Length: 9–10 ft. Width: +/- 23". Thickness: 3". Fin(s): Single fin.
